info.title: EveryCalc API
info.description: Machine-readable versions of the EveryCalc calculators. Each endpoint mirrors an interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz and returns a calculator_url deep link to it.

get.description: Monthly P&I via the amortization formula, plus tax, insurance, PMI, and HOA. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: down_payment_usd
parameters.description: Down payment in USD (wins over down_payment_pct).

parameters.name: include_schedule
parameters.description: Set to true to include the yearly amortization schedule.

get.description: Break-even month and lifetime savings of refinancing. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: new_term_years
parameters.description: New loan term in years; default 30.

get.description: Maximum home price from income using the 28/36 rule. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: annual_income
parameters.description: Gross yearly household income in USD.

parameters.name: monthly_debts
parameters.description: Existing monthly debt payments in USD.

parameters.name: down_payment
parameters.description: Cash available for down payment in USD.

get.description: Monthly payment, total interest, and schedule for an amortizing loan. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: include_schedule
parameters.description: Set to true to include the yearly amortization schedule.

get.description: Future value with monthly contributions and monthly compounding. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: monthly_contribution
parameters.description: Added at the end of each month in USD.

parameters.name: include_schedule
parameters.description: Set to true to include the yearly growth schedule.

get.description: Three modes: percent_of (x percent of y), what_percent (x is what percent of y), percent_change (change from old to new). Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: For percent_of: the percent. For what_percent: the part.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: For percent_of: the whole. For what_percent: the whole.

get.description: Tip amount, total, and per-person split. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.
Convert between hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, and annual pay. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

get.summary: Exact age in years, months, and days
get.description: Exact age from a birth date to a target date, broken into years, months, and days, plus total days lived, total hours lived, the weekday of birth, and days until the next birthday. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: birth_date
parameters.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: target_date
parameters.description: Date to calculate the age as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format. If omitted, today is used, matching the page.

get.description: Monthly payment, amount financed, total interest, and total cost of a car for an auto loan after down payment and trade-in value are subtracted from the vehicle price. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: include_schedule
parameters.description: Set to true to include the yearly amortization schedule.

get.description: Inclusive number of days between two dates, plus business days after optionally excluding weekends and 2026 US federal holidays, calendar weeks, weekend days, and holidays in the range. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: exclude_weekends
parameters.description: Exclude Saturdays and Sundays from the business day count. The page has this checked by default.

parameters.name: exclude_holidays
parameters.description: Exclude 2026 US federal holidays from the business day count.

get.description: Simulates paying off a list of debts month by month with minimum payments plus an extra monthly payment, comparing the avalanche method (highest APR first) with the snowball method (smallest balance first), and reports months to payoff, total interest, payoff order, and the interest and time the avalanche saves. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: debt_names
parameters.description: Comma-separated debt names, in the same order as the balances, APRs, and minimums. Blank names fall back to Debt 1, Debt 2, and so on. Comma-separated list.

parameters.name: debt_balances
parameters.description: Comma-separated debt balances in USD, in the same order as the other debt lists. Debts with a balance of 0 are skipped. Comma-separated list of numbers.

parameters.name: debt_aprs
parameters.description: Comma-separated annual percentage rates, in the same order as the balances. Comma-separated list of numbers.

parameters.name: debt_minimums
parameters.description: Comma-separated minimum monthly payments in USD, in the same order as the balances. Comma-separated list of numbers.

parameters.name: extra_payment
parameters.description: Extra payment each month on top of the minimums, in USD.

get.description: What an amount in today's dollars will buy after a number of years at a given annual inflation rate, what today's basket will cost then, the cumulative price increase percent, and the purchasing power lost. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: include_schedule
parameters.description: Set to true to include the purchasing power schedule in 5 year steps (or about 6 steps for longer horizons), matching the page table.

get.description: Compares the net cost of buying a home (down payment, mortgage payments, tax, insurance, and maintenance, minus principal repaid and appreciation gain) with the total rent paid over the years you plan to stay, and gives a verdict plus the equity built. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: down_payment_pct
parameters.description: Down payment percent of the home price.

parameters.name: stay_years
parameters.description: Years planning to stay in the home.

parameters.name: property_tax_annual
parameters.description: Property tax per year in USD.

parameters.name: home_insurance_annual
parameters.description: Homeowner insurance per year in USD.

parameters.name: maintenance_pct
parameters.description: Maintenance per year as a percent of the home value.

get.description: Compares a Roth and a traditional retirement account at the same pre-tax annual contribution: the Roth invests what is left after tax today and is tax free at withdrawal, the traditional invests the full amount and is taxed at the retirement rate. Reports the winner, both after-tax values, and the tax each side pays. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: annual_contribution
parameters.description: Annual contribution before tax, in USD.

parameters.name: retirement_tax_rate_pct
parameters.description: Expected tax rate in retirement percent.

get.description: Converts a value between units in one category: length, weight, temperature, volume, or speed. Returns the converted result in the page's display precision, the value in base units, and the conversion rate (null for temperature, which uses an offset scale). Unit codes must belong to the chosen category. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: from_unit
parameters.description: Unit code to convert from. Must be a unit of the chosen category: length m, km, cm, mi, ft, in; weight kg, g, lb, oz; temperature C, F, K; volume L, mL, gal, floz; speed ms, kmh, mph.

parameters.name: to_unit
parameters.description: Unit code to convert to. Must be a unit of the chosen category, using the same code lists as from_unit.

get.description: Counts words, characters, characters excluding whitespace, sentences, and paragraphs in a block of text, plus estimated reading time at 200 words per minute and speaking time at 130 words per minute. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

Projected 401k balance with employee contributions capped at 24500 per year, plus an employer match, compounded annually. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: match_pct
parameters.description: Employer match percent of the matched contribution.

parameters.name: match_cap_pct
parameters.description: Percent of salary eligible for the employer match.

get.description: Worst case adjustable rate mortgage simulation with rate caps, compared with a fixed rate loan on total interest, payments, and the breakeven year. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: fixed_period_years
parameters.description: Years before the ARM first adjusts.

parameters.name: fully_indexed_rate_pct
parameters.description: Fully indexed annual percent the ARM can adjust toward.

parameters.name: initial_cap_pct
parameters.description: First adjustment cap in percentage points.

parameters.name: periodic_cap_pct
parameters.description: Cap per later adjustment in percentage points.

parameters.name: lifetime_cap_pct
parameters.description: Lifetime cap above the start rate in percentage points.

get.description: Interest and time saved by paying half the monthly mortgage payment every two weeks instead of monthly. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: current_monthly_payment
parameters.description: Current monthly principal and interest payment in USD; leave at 0 to compute it from balance, rate, and term.

get.description: Body mass index and category, Mifflin-St Jeor basal metabolic rate, total daily energy expenditure, and cut and bulk calorie targets. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: sex
parameters.description: Sex used by the BMR formula: m or f.

parameters.name: activity_factor
parameters.description: Activity multiplier, for example 1.2 sedentary, 1.55 moderately active, 1.9 extremely active; default 1.55.

get.description: Federal tax on ordinary income plus short term gains at ordinary rates, with long term gains stacked at the 0, 15, and 20 percent thresholds for the filing status. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: filing_status
parameters.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), or hoh (head of household).

parameters.name: ordinary_income
parameters.description: Ordinary taxable income in USD, before capital gains.

parameters.name: long_term_gains
parameters.description: Long term capital gains in USD.

parameters.name: short_term_gains
parameters.description: Short term capital gains in USD; default 0.

get.description: Monthly loan payment plus running costs (insurance, fuel, and maintenance, given as annual amounts), total interest, and the five year cost of a car. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: insurance_annual
parameters.description: Insurance cost per year in USD; default 0.

parameters.name: fuel_annual
parameters.description: Fuel cost per year in USD; default 0.

parameters.name: maintenance_annual
parameters.description: Maintenance cost per year in USD; default 0.

get.description: Months and interest to clear a credit card balance with a fixed monthly payment, compared with adding an extra monthly payment. A payment that never clears the balance returns null months and interest. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: extra_payment
parameters.description: Extra payment added each month in USD; default 0.

get.description: Target emergency fund for a chosen number of months of essential expenses, the remaining gap, percent funded, and months to fill it at a monthly savings rate. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: months_of_coverage
parameters.description: Months of expenses to cover, typically 3, 6, 9, or 12; default 6.

parameters.name: monthly_savings
parameters.description: Added per month in USD; default 0.

get.description: Federal income tax after pretax deductions and the standard deduction for the filing status, with AGI, taxable income, marginal rate, and effective rate. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: filing_status
parameters.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), or hoh (head of household).

get.description: Lease outlay over the lease term versus buy outlay net of equity in the car at the same point, with the winning option and the net cost difference. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: lease_down_payment
parameters.description: Lease down payment in USD; default 0.

parameters.name: residual_pct
parameters.description: Residual value as a percent of MSRP at lease end.

parameters.name: money_factor
parameters.description: Lease money factor, for example 0.0025; default 0.

parameters.name: buy_down_payment
parameters.description: Buy down payment in USD; default 0.

get.summary: Net worth from asset and liability lists
get.description: Net worth, total assets, and total liabilities from comma separated asset and liability values, with optional matching names for the largest asset and liability. Only positive values count, as on the page. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: asset_values
parameters.description: Asset values in USD, comma separated, in the same order as asset_names. Comma-separated list of numbers.

parameters.name: asset_names
parameters.description: Asset names, comma separated, in the same order as asset_values. Comma-separated list.

parameters.name: liability_values
parameters.description: Liability values in USD, comma separated, in the same order as liability_names. Comma-separated list of numbers.

parameters.name: liability_names
parameters.description: Liability names, comma separated, in the same order as liability_values. Comma-separated list.

get.description: Per paycheck net pay after federal income tax, FICA (Social Security capped at 184500 of wages, Medicare, and the additional Medicare tax), a flat state tax rate, and pretax deductions. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: pay_frequency
parameters.description: Paychecks per year: 52 weekly, 26 biweekly, 24 semimonthly, or 12 monthly; default 26.

parameters.name: filing_status
parameters.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), or hoh (head of household).

parameters.name: pretax_deductions
parameters.description: Annual pretax deductions in USD; default 0.

parameters.name: state_tax_rate_pct
parameters.description: Flat state tax rate percent, applied to the full salary as on the page.

get.description: Annual and monthly property tax from the home value minus any exemption, at the given tax rate, with assessed value and effective rate. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

Whether a raise beats inflation: nominal new salary, inflation adjusted real salary, the real percent change, and a real raise, real pay cut, or flat verdict. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: inflation_pct
parameters.description: Inflation percent over the same period.

get.description: Projected retirement balance from current savings plus monthly contributions with monthly compounding, total contributions, growth, and a 4 percent rule withdrawal figure. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: current_savings
parameters.description: Current retirement savings in USD; default 0.

get.description: Value of converting to a Roth now, with the tax paid out of the converted amount, versus leaving the money in a traditional account taxed at the retirement rate, after growth. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: conversion_amount
parameters.description: Amount considered for conversion in USD.

parameters.name: current_tax_rate_pct
parameters.description: Tax rate percent if converting now.

parameters.name: retirement_tax_rate_pct
parameters.description: Expected tax rate percent in retirement.

get.summary: SBA loan payment with financed fee
get.description: Monthly payment for an SBA loan with the guarantee fee percent financed into the loan, plus the amount financed, total interest, and total cost. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: guarantee_fee_pct
parameters.description: Guarantee fee percent of the loan amount, financed into the loan; default 0.

get.description: Primary insurance amount from the bend point formula (1286 and 7749) applied to average indexed monthly earnings, with monthly benefits at ages 62, 67, and 70. Annual earnings, when given above 0, override AIME as annual divided by 12. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: aime_monthly
parameters.description: Average indexed monthly earnings in USD.

parameters.name: annual_earnings
parameters.description: Annual earnings in USD; when above 0 it overrides aime_monthly. Default 0.

get.description: Scores all five AFT events (deadlift, hand-release push-ups, sprint-drag-carry, plank, 2-mile run) from 0 to 100 each using the 17-21 anchor tables, for a 500-point total. Combat MOS scoring is sex-neutral and requires 350 total with every event at 60 or above; the general standard requires every event at 60 or above. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: standard
parameters.description: Scoring standard: general or combat MOS.

parameters.name: sex
parameters.description: Sex for the scoring tables (ignored for combat, which is sex-neutral).

parameters.name: sprint_drag_carry_time
parameters.description: Sprint-drag-carry time as m:ss (or total seconds).

parameters.name: plank_time
parameters.description: Plank hold time as m:ss (or total seconds).

parameters.name: run_time
parameters.description: 2-mile run time as m:ss (or total seconds).

get.description: Monthly Basic Allowance for Housing from the 2026 RC/Transient baseline rate table by pay grade, with or without dependents, plus the annualized amount. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: pay_grade
parameters.description: Pay grade, e.g. E-5 or O-3. O-7+ covers O-7 to O-10.

parameters.name: dependents
parameters.description: Whether the rate is with or without dependents.

get.description: Pension-only comparison of the legacy High-3 system (2.5 percent per year of service) against the Blended Retirement System (2.0 percent per year) on the same high-3 average basic pay: monthly, annual, and 30-year lifetime differences. Excludes TSP matching, continuation pay, COLA, and taxes. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: years_of_service
parameters.description: Years of service, clamped by the page to 20 to 40.

parameters.name: high3_monthly_avg
parameters.description: High-3 average monthly basic pay in USD.

get.summary: Post-9/11 GI Bill entitlement and benefits
get.description: Months of the 36-month Post-9/11 GI Bill entitlement remaining, tuition coverage percent, maximum annual books stipend, and Monthly Housing Allowance treatment for the given benefit tier and enrollment level. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: tier_pct
parameters.description: Post-9/11 GI Bill benefit tier percent based on qualifying service.

parameters.name: months_used
parameters.description: Months of entitlement already used, 0 to 36.

parameters.name: enrollment
parameters.description: Enrollment level: full-time, part-time (over half-time), or half-time or less.

get.summary: Leave and Earnings Statement (LES) net pay
get.description: Net pay from a Leave and Earnings Statement: sums the entitlement lines (base pay, BAH, BAS, other) and deduction lines (federal tax, FICA, state tax, SGLI, TSP, other), and returns net pay plus deductions as a percent of entitlements. Negative line items count as zero, as on the page. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

Monthly basic pay from the 2026 pay table for a pay grade and years of service, plus the annualized amount. Grade E1B is the special E-1 rate for the first 4 months of service. Combinations the table does not authorize return authorized=false with null pay. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: pay_grade
parameters.description: Pay grade. E1B means E-1 with under 4 months of service.

get.description: Monthly retired pay estimate: years of service times the system multiplier (2.0 percent per year for BRS, 2.5 percent per year for High-3) times the high-3 average monthly basic pay, before taxes, plus annual and 20-year lifetime amounts. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Retirement system: brs (2.0 percent per year) or high3 (2.5 percent per year).

parameters.name: high3_monthly_avg
parameters.description: High-3 average monthly basic pay in USD.

get.description: Estimated PCS move money: Dislocation Allowance (DLA) plus Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE, days capped at 21) plus the gross Personally Procured Move (PPM) reimbursement, with the PPM profit after moving costs. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: tle_days
parameters.description: Temporary Lodging Expense days, capped at 21.

parameters.name: ppm_rate
parameters.description: PPM reimbursement rate per pound in USD.

parameters.name: ppm_costs
parameters.description: Actual PPM moving costs in USD.

get.summary: SGLI vs private life insurance cost
get.description: Cost comparison of SGLI (0.06 USD per 1,000 USD of coverage per month plus a 1 USD monthly fee) against a private term premium over the given number of years: monthly and total SGLI cost, total private cost, and which is cheaper. The page's age field is not used by its calculation and is not a parameter here. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: coverage
parameters.description: Life insurance coverage amount in USD.

parameters.name: private_monthly
parameters.description: Private term insurance monthly premium in USD.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Comparison horizon in years (minimum 1, as on the page).

get.description: Projected TSP balance with annual employee contributions (capped at the 24,500 USD elective deferral limit used by the page) plus, when matching is on, the BRS agency contribution: 1 percent automatic plus a match of 100 percent of the first 3 percent of pay and 50 percent of the next 2 percent. Contributions are treated as annual amounts compounded with the starting balance, as on the page. The page's Roth percent field is not used by its calculation and is not a parameter here. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: salary
parameters.description: Annual salary (basic pay basis) in USD.

parameters.name: match_on
parameters.description: Whether BRS agency automatic and matching contributions apply.

get.description: Monthly VA disability compensation from the 2026 rates (2.8 percent COLA, effective Dec 1, 2025) for a combined rating from 10 to 100 percent and a dependent status, plus the annualized amount. Dependency add-ons begin at 30 percent. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: dependents
parameters.description: Dependent status: alone, spouse, spouseChild, spouse2Children, or vetChild.

get.description: Composite, STEM, and ELA scores from the four ACT section scores, each clamped to 1 to 36 exactly as the page does. The composite is the rounded average of the four sections. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: english
parameters.description: English section score, 1 to 36 (clamped and rounded as on the page).

parameters.name: math
parameters.description: Math section score, 1 to 36 (clamped and rounded as on the page).

parameters.name: reading
parameters.description: Reading section score, 1 to 36 (clamped and rounded as on the page).

parameters.name: science
parameters.description: Science section score, 1 to 36 (clamped and rounded as on the page).

get.description: Predicted AP score from 1 to 5 using the page bands on the weighted composite percent: multiple choice and free response contributions are weighted by the exam split, then banded at 70, 55, 40, and 25 percent. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: mc_weight_pct
parameters.description: Multiple choice weight percent for the exam (the page presets are 50, 40, 45, and 60 depending on the exam); default 50.

get.description: Rough acceptance chance: a selectivity tier base rate (92, 80, 50, 20, or 5 percent) adjusted by GPA and test score bands, clamped to 1 to 99 percent and labeled Safety, Target, Reach, or High reach. SAT is used when provided, otherwise ACT. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: sat
parameters.description: SAT total score, or 0 to leave out; default 0.

parameters.name: act
parameters.description: ACT composite score, used only when no SAT is given, or 0 to leave out; default 0.

parameters.name: tier_base_pct
parameters.description: Selectivity tier base rate percent from the page: 92 open admission, 80 less selective, 50 selective, 20 highly selective, 5 most selective; default 20.

get.summary: College major ROI by median salary
get.description: Payback years, lifetime earnings minus degree cost, and salary to cost ratio for a major, using the page table of approximate median early career salaries by major. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: major
parameters.description: Major name from the page salary table; default Nursing.

get.summary: College degree ROI and break-even year
get.description: Earnings premium of a degree salary over a no degree baseline salary, both growing at the same annual raise rate, plus the net gain after degree cost, the break-even year, and the return multiple on cost. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: starting_salary
parameters.description: Starting yearly salary with the degree in USD.

parameters.name: annual_raise_pct
parameters.description: Annual raise percent applied to both salaries; default 3.

parameters.name: baseline_salary
parameters.description: Starting yearly salary without the degree in USD.

get.description: Compares the annual dorm cost with an apartment: monthly rent over the number of months, plus annual utilities, extra food cost, and commuting cost. Returns both annual totals, the difference, and which is cheaper. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Months of rent per year; default 12.

parameters.name: utilities_annual
parameters.description: Annual utilities cost for the apartment in USD.

parameters.name: food_extra_annual
parameters.description: Annual extra food cost versus the dorm meal plan in USD.

parameters.name: commute_annual
parameters.description: Annual commuting cost for the apartment in USD.

get.description: Simplified Student Aid Index estimate using the page formula: parent income at 22 percent plus parent assets at 12 percent, student income above the 11770 income protection allowance at 50 percent plus student assets at 20 percent, plus an estimated Pell Grant of 7395 minus the SAI, floored at zero. Household size mirrors the page input; the simplified formula does not use it. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: household_size
parameters.description: Household size, as on the page; the simplified page formula does not use it; default 4.

get.description: Score needed on the final exam to reach a desired course grade, with the best and worst possible course grades. Inputs are clamped as on the page: grades to 0 to 100 and the final weight to 1 to 100. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: final_weight_pct
parameters.description: Final exam weight percent of the course grade.

get.summary: GPA from letter grades and credits
get.description: Credit weighted GPA on the 4.0 scale using the page grade points: A+ and A 4.0, A- 3.7, B+ 3.3, B 3.0, B- 2.7, C+ 2.3, C 2.0, C- 1.7, D+ 1.3, D 1.0, F 0.0. Grades and credits are matched by position. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: grades
parameters.description: Comma-separated letter grades, e.g. A,B+,A-,B. Comma-separated list.

parameters.name: credits
parameters.description: Comma-separated credit hours matching grades. Comma-separated list of numbers.

get.summary: GPA needed this term to hit a target
get.description: Term GPA required over the planned credits to reach a target cumulative GPA, the maximum reachable cumulative GPA with straight As, and the grade mix the required GPA implies, using the page thresholds. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

Annual salary premium after a graduate degree, break-even years on the total cost, and lifetime net over the career years, using the page formulas. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: total_cost
parameters.description: Total graduate degree cost in USD.

parameters.name: post_degree_salary
parameters.description: Expected yearly salary after the degree in USD.

get.summary: GRE score estimate from practice results
get.description: Estimated GRE verbal and quant scores on the 130 to 170 scale: 130 plus the fraction of questions correct times 40, per section, plus the total. The optional writing score is clamped to 0 to 6 as on the page. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

Credits still needed per subject against the page requirement table for the selected state (Texas, California, New York, Florida, or Illinois). Remaining per subject is required minus earned, floored at zero. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State code for the requirement table; default TX.

get.summary: LSAT score estimate from three sections
get.description: Estimated LSAT scaled score on the 120 to 180 scale: 120 plus the overall fraction correct across the three sections times 60, with accuracy and the page score band. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

get.summary: MCAT score estimate from four sections
get.description: Estimated MCAT section scores on the 118 to 132 scale: 118 plus the fraction correct times 14, per section, plus the total on the 472 to 528 scale. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

Progress across the 13 premed prerequisites on the page, in page order: General Chemistry I and II, Organic Chemistry I and II, Biology I and II, Physics I and II, Biochemistry, Psychology, Sociology, Statistics or Calculus, English (1 year). The first 11 are the MCAT core courses. Returns counts done, in progress, and planned, percent done, and whether all core courses are done. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Comma-separated status for each of the 13 prerequisites in page order, each one of not, plan, prog, done, e.g. done,done,not,not,done,done,not,not,not,done,not,not,done. Comma-separated list.

get.description: Monthly budget from job, parent, and aid income against rent, food, books, transport, and fun spending. Returns total income, total expenses, the balance, and the largest category with its share of expenses. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: parent_contribution
parameters.description: Monthly contribution from parents in USD.

parameters.name: aid_income
parameters.description: Monthly financial aid income in USD.

parameters.name: books
parameters.description: Monthly books and supplies spending in USD.

parameters.name: fun
parameters.description: Monthly fun and entertainment spending in USD.

get.summary: Student loan payoff time and interest
get.description: Months to pay off a student loan and the total interest, computed month by month exactly as the page does. With an extra monthly payment, also returns the interest and months saved. Returns null fields and never_payoff true when the payment does not cover monthly interest. Payoff dates are not returned because the page derives them from the current date. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: extra_payment
parameters.description: Extra monthly payment in USD; default 100, the page default.

get.description: Net cost of buying new, buying used, renting, and digital for a textbook. Purchase options are reduced by the resale value (floored at zero), and the cheapest option is returned. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: buy_new_price
parameters.description: Price to buy the book new in USD.

parameters.name: buy_used_price
parameters.description: Price to buy the book used in USD.

parameters.name: resale_value
parameters.description: Expected resale value after the term in USD.

get.summary: Terms left to finish a degree
get.description: Credits remaining, terms remaining at the credits taken per term, years remaining at the terms per year, and credits per year. The graduation date label is not returned because the page derives it from the current date. Results match the interactive calculator at everycalc.xyz; every response includes a calculator_url deep link to it.

parameters.name: required_credits
parameters.description: Total credits required for the degree.
